candidate_adjudications.rationale: No direct exact karaka-kendra replication in this archive batch. No personality transport or added weight.

Full text is available. Four reused applications do not establish a single general tightness/applying rule: paired spouses, noon dates in two cohorts, outcome-inspected thresholds, inconsistent tightness and female direction reversal. No executable one- or two-degree allowance.

Credit the 61-person new-person test and conditional small p-values; eight of nine survive Holm. The biographical target is chart-conditioned, and shuffling finished target labels does not preserve that shared-chart dependence. Biography specificity under a frozen correct pipeline null and independently measured traits remain unestablished. Same software and training optimization alone are not disqualifications. The 2024 N250 is reuse.

Direct original is Correlation38(1),2026,39-56, not the 2024 book-sales paper. Reported 48/68 versus26/73 contrast remains unreconstructed from individual scores; rendered tables contain subtraction and orientation contradictions. Names/GPT knowledge, lexical normalization and unmatched geography require controls. North73 reused; at least Allende and Arrau in south68 also occur in the 2023 N61 sample. Do not claim the aggregate is false or the68 are all new.

Retain the two-source Mercury-Mars conjunction finding and corrected within-paper threshold, alongside temporal-third and other-aspect failures. Event denominators, within-person dependence, case ascertainment, date-only precision and unmatched calendar-day controls prevent person-level inference. Neither full-text recovery nor an aggregate replication can lift the categorical high-stakes exclusion.

Separate sectors from aspects. Reused Gauquelin cohorts, precision-direction failure, trait-expectancy artefact and unsuccessful family comparison do not provide a new exact independently replicated sector rule. Positive pooled ruler summaries remain recorded, not transported to personality.

No exact trait-by-aspect/orb/angularity mapping earns activation. Negative tests constrain their tested definitions, not all possible astrology. Keep all secondary templates inactive and do not use them to rescue TN001.
No directly responsive new original in the25. Previous exact-mapping and independent-validation limitations remain; high-stakes exclusions unchanged.

primary_time_twin_adjudication: No new real near-time/personality evidence. Tarvainen2018 supplies a synthetic method counterexample, not a reanalysis of Dean outcomes. TN001 remains an unvalidated observational association protocol, not a test of all astrology or an individual prediction system.
multiplicity_adjudication: No common pooled p-value or literal multiplication by all historical papers. Count the actual selection paths and endpoint families. Conditional9-endpointHolm does not erase CF003. Rerun model selection for development whole-search nulls; do not redo frozen training search during genuinely untouched validation.
null_adjudication: ForCF003, preserve each chart, reassign appropriately matched biography profiles and regenerate its ten chart-conditioned target portraits/rankings before comparison to the frozen predictor. Finished-target shuffling alone is inadequate to test chart-biography specificity. ForCF004, reproduce individual scores and orientation first, then use assignment-respecting profile/null controls, not assumed50/50 symmetry. Freeze unaffected independent stochastic outputs; regenerate affected stages and test identity/world-knowledge separately.
